bic_trace_step.reason: In imx_hsio_probe() (lines 547-550), if the 'fsl,refclk-pad-mode' property is not found, priv->refclk_pad is set to NULL. However, in imx_hsio_configure_clk_pad() (line 263), the code unconditionally calls strncmp(priv->refclk_pad, "output", 6) without checking if priv->refclk_pad is NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference.
